title: Relativistic particles without fields
claims: A Lorentz-invariant multiparticle quantum system can be defined without fields.
Creation and annihilation operators generate and normalize the particle basis.
The free Hamiltonian is diagonal in occupation number.
Interactions change particle number.

title: Local disturbances and causality
claims: A relativistic disturbance propagates inside the light cone.
A local field operator is an operator-valued family labeled by spacetime points.
The spacetime label is a parameter rather than a quantum-mechanical position operator.

title: Poincare covariance
claims: A Poincare transformation carries the field at x to the field at the transformed point.
The symmetry is represented by a unitary operator on the Hilbert space.
Infinitesimal transformations define momentum and Lorentz generators.
Their composition law yields the Poincare algebra.

title: Microcausality and the free scalar field
claims: Spacelike-separated local field operators commute.
The free particle Hamiltonian admits a local scalar field operator.
The invariant momentum-space commutator proves microcausality.
The field transforms covariantly under Poincare symmetry.

title: Postulates and the next formulation
claims: The Hamiltonian construction suggests four local-QFT postulates.
